content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Rochester

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: Verify you meet PMI's education and project-management experience requirements for the PMP credential. Rochester professionals in healthcare, manufacturing, and technology sectors typically qualify. Review PMI's official eligibility criteria and gather documentation of your background before enrolling.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course. Our Rochester-focused cohorts meet synchronously, allowing you to learn alongside local project managers while maintaining your work schedule. You'll receive a certificate of completion upon finishing all required coursework.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Register with PMI and submit your formal application, including proof of your training completion certificate and professional experience. Pay the exam fee to secure your testing eligibility. PMI will review and approve your application before you can schedule your exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study guides, and instructor support—to build confidence. Schedule your proctored exam at a PMI-approved testing center. You'll receive your pass/fail result immediately upon completion.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: Earn professional development units (PDUs) throughout the standard three-year renewal cycle by attending training, conferences, or volunteering. Submit your renewal application and fee to PMI before your credential expires. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing learning pathways to support your continued growth.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?
fq_items.answer: No. All of our PMP training is delivered live-virtual via video conference, so {city} professionals attend from wherever they work. No commuting or hotel required.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy is a PMI Premier Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our curriculum is aligned to PMI’s current Examination Content Outline and our contact hours are fully accepted by PMI.
